verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls docs say consent state drives both GDPR consent and the CCPA data-sale opt-out. They also document forwarding rules that stop data reaching destinations, such as "Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present." A dedicated Consent Filters guide also exists, so the core of downstream consent enforcement is covered. Missing for 10: detail on how consent is captured via the SDKs/APIs, explicit documentation of per-purpose consent categories mapped to individual destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works automatically.
